metadata.title: Verified Indian Government Education Scholarships and Farmer Schemes
metadata.verification_policy: Scheme descriptions are based on official Government of India portals or official scheme portals. Eligibility, benefits, rates, institution lists, state implementation, and application windows can change; applicants must check the linked official portal and current guidelines before applying. No scheme is described as universally open unless the official portal confirms it.
notes: These are curated schemes, not a ranking of guaranteed benefits or eligibility.
The National Scholarship Portal lists academic-year-specific application and verification dates. Dates in the portal can change.
For state-implemented schemes, availability and operational details may vary by state.

schemes.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
schemes.administering_authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
schemes.purpose: Provides financial assistance to meritorious students from families with limited income to help them continue higher education after Class XII.

benefits.summary: Scholarship support is provided at the rates and for the course stages specified in the current scheme guidelines.
benefits.amount_note: Check the current CSSS guidelines on the official portal for the applicable annual amount, course stage, renewal conditions, and payment rules; do not rely on older summaries.

eligibility: Applicants must satisfy the current merit/ranking criteria based on Class XII results and the applicable board-wise selection procedure.
Family income must be within the ceiling specified in the current CSSS guidelines.
The student must be pursuing an eligible regular course at a recognised institution and meet the scheme's other conditions.
Renewal depends on the prescribed academic performance, attendance, and other conditions in the current guidelines.
how_to_apply: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal.
Choose the CSSS application for the relevant academic year and submit accurate details and required documents.
Ensure institution and authority verification is completed before the portal deadline.
documents_commonly_needed: Income certificate or prescribed income declaration
Aadhaar or other identification as required
schemes.application_status_as_of: The NSP's 2026-27 page stated that renewal applications were open with a student deadline of 31 October 2026. Confirm the live portal for fresh/renewal eligibility and any revised deadlines.
schemes.verification_notes: The live NSP listing confirms the scheme's presence and 2026-27 portal information. Exact eligibility and rates should be taken from the linked current-year scheme specification/FAQ.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.administering_authority: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
schemes.purpose: Helps meritorious students from economically weaker sections continue their education at the secondary stage and reduce dropout after Class VIII.

benefits.duration: Normally from Class IX through Class XII, subject to selection, renewal, and scheme conditions.

eligibility: Student must be selected through the state/UT-level selection examination and satisfy current scheme requirements.
Parental income and minimum academic marks must meet the current guidelines.
Student must attend an eligible government, government-aided, or local-body school; excluded school categories and other conditions are set by the current guidelines.
how_to_apply: Check the state/UT education department's NMMSS examination notification and apply through its prescribed process.
After selection, complete the scholarship application/renewal process on the National Scholarship Portal as directed.
documents_commonly_needed: Caste/disability certificate if relevant under applicable rules
schemes.application_status_as_of: Application and selection timelines are state/UT-specific; check the current state examination notice and NSP.
schemes.verification_notes: The Ministry of Education's official material identifies the scheme and the ₹12,000 annual scholarship. Verify the latest income threshold, marks, school exclusions, and process in current guidelines.

schemes.name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
schemes.administering_authority: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.purpose: Supports eligible Scheduled Caste students pursuing studies beyond Class XII in institutions notified under the scheme.

benefits.summary: Financial support for eligible costs as defined in the current guidelines, potentially including tuition and specified academic/living allowances.
benefits.amount_note: Amounts, covered components, income ceiling, institution list, and slot limits must be checked in the current 2026-27 guidelines.

eligibility: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category and meet the current family-income ceiling.
Admission must be in an institution/course covered by the current notified list and scheme rules.
Selection, slot availability, and other conditions are governed by the current guidelines.
how_to_apply: Check the current 2026-27 scheme guidelines and notified institution list on the Ministry website.
Apply through the National Scholarship Portal when the scheme application window is available.
Submit the required category, income, admission, and bank details and complete verification.
schemes.application_status_as_of: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment published 2026-27 guidelines on 24 June 2026. Check NSP for the live application window.
schemes.verification_notes: The Ministry's scheme page and 2026-27 guideline listing are authoritative. Do not infer a benefit amount without consulting the current guidelines.

schemes.name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students — Scholarship component (Top Class)
schemes.purpose: Supports eligible Scheduled Tribe students pursuing specified higher/professional education in institutions identified by the Ministry.

benefits.summary: Support can include tuition/admission and other eligible fees, stipend/living support, and book/computer allowances, as provided in the current guidelines.
benefits.amount_note: The precise limits, covered costs, number of fresh awards, and eligible institution list must be confirmed in the current scheme guidelines.

eligibility: Applicant must be an ST student.
Family income must satisfy the scheme's current ceiling; the Ministry's scheme page has published a ₹6 lakh annual ceiling, which should be reconfirmed against current guidelines.
Course and institution must be covered by the current notified list, and selection is subject to merit and scheme rules.
how_to_apply: Review the Ministry of Tribal Affairs' current Top Class scholarship guidelines and eligible institution list.
Apply through the National Scholarship Portal when the scheme is open.
Complete OTR, upload required documents, and follow institution/authority verification.
schemes.application_status_as_of: The NSP listing showed the scheme for academic year 2026-27 with a student application deadline of 31 October 2026. Verify the live portal before applying.
schemes.verification_notes: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs confirms the scheme and its broad coverage. Use the current official guidelines for final eligibility and benefit limits.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (PMS-SC)
schemes.administering_authority: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, with State/UT governments implementing the scheme
schemes.purpose: Provides educational financial assistance to eligible SC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary level to help them complete their education.

benefits.summary: Scholarship support and eligible compulsory/non-refundable fees and maintenance allowance are determined under the current scheme rules and the student's course category.
benefits.amount_note: Do not use a single universal amount: the payable amount depends on course group, eligible charges, state implementation, and current guidelines.

eligibility: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
The course/institution must be eligible under current scheme rules.
Family income must be within the applicable ceiling and the student must meet other current conditions.
how_to_apply: Check the state/UT scholarship portal and the National Scholarship Portal for the applicable application route.
Complete the application with caste, income, course, institution, and bank details.
Track institute and government verification; retain acknowledgement and application number.
schemes.application_status_as_of: Application windows and implementation steps vary by state/UT and academic year. Confirm the current portal notice.
schemes.verification_notes: The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment identifies PMS-SC as a centrally sponsored scheme. The state/UT portal determines the applicable process and current-year timeline.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.administering_authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.purpose: Provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families to help meet agricultural input and related household needs.

benefits.amount: ₹6,000 per eligible farmer family per year
benefits.payment_frequency: Paid in three instalments of ₹2,000 each, subject to eligibility and successful verification.

eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to the scheme's operational guidelines.
Exclusion categories apply, including specified institutional landholders and certain higher-income/professional or public-office categories.
Land records, Aadhaar/e-KYC, bank account and other required records must satisfy current verification requirements.
how_to_apply: Use the official PM-KISAN portal's New Farmer Registration facility or seek assistance from the designated local agriculture/revenue office.
Complete e-KYC and ensure land records and bank/Aadhaar details match.
Use the official beneficiary status page to check registration and payment status.
schemes.application_status_as_of: The scheme portal is active; eligibility and payment status must be checked against current records and official portal notices.
schemes.verification_notes: The official PM-KISAN portal and operational guidelines are the source of truth for exclusions, registration, e-KYC and payment status.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.administering_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.purpose: Provides crop insurance protection against notified crop losses caused by specified natural risks and other covered perils, helping stabilise farm income.

benefits.summary: Insurance indemnity for covered losses, subject to notified crops/areas, policy terms, assessment procedures, and applicable exclusions.
benefits.farmer_premium_note: For notified food and oilseed crops, farmer premium rates are generally capped at 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; confirm the season's notification and crop-specific terms.

eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified insurance units/areas during the applicable season.
Both owner cultivators and eligible tenant/sharecropper farmers may be covered when they meet the state's documentation and scheme requirements.
Enrollment deadlines, documents and notified crops/areas vary by state and season.
how_to_apply: Check whether the crop and area are notified for the current season on the official PMFBY portal or through the state agriculture department.
Apply through the official portal, authorised channel, bank, or designated Common Service Centre as permitted for that season.
Keep the application acknowledgement, land/cultivation documents, bank details, and policy information.
documents_commonly_needed: Land records or valid cultivation/tenancy evidence
schemes.application_status_as_of: Season-specific; check the official portal for the current state, crop, insurer, and last date.
schemes.verification_notes: PMFBY's official FAQ explains its crop-loss protection objective. Premiums and enrollment are tied to notified crops, seasons and state notifications; not every crop/area is automatically covered.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.government_level: Central framework delivered through participating banks
schemes.administering_authority: Government of India/RBI/NABARD framework, delivered by eligible banks
schemes.purpose: Provides eligible farmers with revolving credit for cultivation expenses and other permitted agricultural and allied activities, subject to bank appraisal and scheme rules.

benefits.summary: Access to a bank-sanctioned credit limit for eligible farming needs; limit, interest, collateral/security and repayment terms depend on the applicable rules and bank sanction.
benefits.interest_note: Interest subvention or prompt-repayment benefits, where applicable, are governed by current Government/RBI directions and bank terms; do not assume every borrower receives the same effective rate.

eligibility: Owner cultivators, individually or jointly.
Tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers, subject to bank documentation and rules.
Eligible self-help groups and joint liability groups of farmers, including tenant/sharecropper groups.
how_to_apply: Apply through a participating bank's official website/branch or the route listed by the bank.
Provide the application and identity, address, land/cultivation and other requested documents.
The bank assesses eligibility and sanctions a limit under its applicable rules.
schemes.application_status_as_of: Applications are handled by participating banks; product availability and processing requirements are bank-specific.
schemes.verification_notes: The Government of India's myScheme page lists eligible applicant categories and application routes. The sanction amount and terms are not guaranteed by the scheme listing.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) — Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)
schemes.administering_authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare and designated State/UT implementing departments
schemes.purpose: Promotes water-use efficiency at farm level, particularly micro-irrigation such as drip and sprinkler systems, to improve irrigation efficiency and crop productivity.

benefits.summary: Eligible assistance for approved micro-irrigation systems, subject to current central/state guidelines, beneficiary category, cost norms, area limits and available allocation.
benefits.amount_note: Subsidy rates and limits can differ by state and beneficiary category; no universal subsidy percentage is promised here.

eligibility: Farmers meeting the current state/UT programme criteria and installing eligible systems through the approved process.
Land, crop, system specifications, prior-benefit restrictions and other conditions are determined by current guidelines and state implementation.
how_to_apply: Contact the state agriculture/horticulture or designated micro-irrigation department.
Confirm the current beneficiary registration process, approved equipment/vendor requirements and subsidy norms before purchase or installation.
Complete inspection/verification and documentation required by the implementing agency.
schemes.application_status_as_of: Implementation and application windows are state-specific; confirm the currently active component and allocation with the State/UT department.
schemes.verification_notes: The official PMKSY portal and PDMC operational guidelines describe the programme framework. The linked guidelines are an archived/revised document; applicants must obtain current state norms before making a purchase.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.administering_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.purpose: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme intended to provide old-age social security to eligible small and marginal farmers.

benefits.amount: Assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after attaining 60 years of age, subject to scheme conditions.
benefits.contribution_note: Eligible enrolled farmers contribute a monthly amount based on entry age; the Central Government makes a matching contribution under scheme rules.

eligibility: Generally intended for small and marginal farmers aged 18–40 years with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares, subject to current scheme conditions.
Specified exclusions apply, including categories covered by other statutory social security schemes or certain pension/taxpayer categories as defined in the guidelines.
Confirm current eligibility and exclusions with the official portal or a designated enrolment centre.
how_to_apply: Check the official PM-KMY portal for current eligibility and enrolment instructions.
Enrol through the authorised Common Service Centre or other official route stated by the scheme.
Provide identity, landholding, bank and contact details and authorise the prescribed contribution mechanism.
documents_commonly_needed: Other details required by the enrolment system
schemes.application_status_as_of: Confirm live enrolment availability and current conditions through the official portal or authorised CSC.
schemes.verification_notes: Pension eligibility and contribution depend on age at entry and scheme rules. The pension is not an immediate cash grant and requires enrolment and contributions.

schemes.name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (RTF - Full Tuition Fee Reimbursement)
schemes.administering_authority: Social Welfare & Higher Education Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.purpose: Provides 100% complete tuition fee reimbursement directly to eligible students pursuing Polytechnic, ITI, Degree, B.Tech/Engineering, MCA, MBA, and Pharmacy courses in Andhra Pradesh.

benefits.summary: 100% full tuition fee reimbursement fixed by APHERMC, credited quarterly to avoid student fee burden.

eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent resident/domicile of Andhra Pradesh.
Must be admitted to a recognized ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, B.Tech/Engineering, or Professional course through convener quota (EAPCET/ICET).
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (verified via MeeSeva Integrated Certificate).
Mandatory minimum 75% college attendance required for quarterly disbursement.
Candidate's family must not own a four-wheeler (excluding taxi/auto) or exceed land ceilings (10 acres wetland / 25 acres dryland).
how_to_apply: Ensure college admission details are uploaded on the JnanaBhumi portal by the college nodal officer.
Complete biometric/e-KYC authentication at the college or Grama/Ward Sachivalayam.
Link MeeSeva Integrated Caste and Income Certificate with the application on JnanaBhumi.
Quarterly verification by Welfare and Education Assistant (WEA) at Sachivalayam.
documents_commonly_needed: College Admission Allotment Order & Fee Receipt
Mother's Bank Passbook (NPCI Aadhaar-seeded for DBT)
schemes.application_status_as_of: Active for Academic Year 2026-27 on JnanaBhumi portal.
schemes.verification_notes: Official Andhra Pradesh State Government welfare portal for post-matric higher education fee reimbursement.

schemes.name: Jagananna Vasathi Deevena (MTF - Hostel & Food Maintenance Allowance)
schemes.administering_authority: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Dept, Government of Andhra Pradesh
schemes.purpose: Provides annual financial assistance to cover food, hostel, and boarding expenses for students pursuing higher education.

benefits.amount: ₹20,000 per year for B.Tech/Degree students (₹15,000 for Polytechnic, ₹10,000 for ITI)
benefits.summary: ₹20,000 per annum for B.Tech/Degree students, credited in two equal installments directly to the mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

eligibility: Domicile of Andhra Pradesh pursuing post-intermediate higher education (Degree, B.Tech, PG).
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Student must be actively pursuing ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, B.Tech, or Professional course.
Mother of the student must possess an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT transfer.
how_to_apply: Integrated application linked with Jagananna Vidya Deevena on JnanaBhumi portal.
College nodal officer verifies attendance and bonafide status.
DBT disbursement released directly to student mother's bank account.
documents_commonly_needed: Aadhaar Card of student and mother
schemes.verification_notes: State scheme providing maintenance allowances to prevent student dropouts.

schemes.name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scholarship
schemes.administering_authority: Centre for e-Governance, Government of Karnataka
schemes.purpose: Consolidated state scholarship portal providing fee reimbursement, maintenance allowances, and hostel fee concessions for Karnataka students.

benefits.summary: Full or partial tuition fee waiver and monthly maintenance allowance credited through Aadhaar NPCI DBT.

eligibility: Permanent resident / domicile of Karnataka state.
Pursuing post-matric courses (PUC, Diploma, ITI, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, Postgraduation).
Family income ceiling: SC/ST up to ₹2,50,000; Cat-1 up to ₹2,50,000; 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B up to ₹1,00,000.
Must possess valid 15-digit Nadakacheri RD number for Caste & Income certificates.
how_to_apply: Register for SSP Student ID on https://ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in/.
Link Aadhaar with NPCI seeding at bank branch.
Enter Nadakacheri RD numbers for automated digital certificate verification.
Submit college admission number and verify e-Attestation through college nodal officer.
documents_commonly_needed: Nadakacheri Caste & Income Certificate RD Numbers
